mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, which can lead to a boost in the overall economy, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which can drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 7% indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts and increasing retail sales indicates strong demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which can drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high interest rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment and decreasing payroll employment indicates a weak labor market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment and low payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP indicates decreased economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in recession periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
